offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai)
offerings.pricing: Token-based: Prototype Development 1B tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment 11B tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens). Every search request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10000 tokens.
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；每次搜索从 10,000 tokens 起
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果的 URL 和网页内容，每项为干净的 LLM-friendly text；JSON 模式返回五项列表
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；免费/付费密钥100 RPM，高级密钥1000 RPM。
